I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 261 seats. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

I also pointed out that the 185 from August 2025 is a different number. That was the seat count under Amendment No. 1, which Dana corrected from 180 at the time, so it shouldn't go in the tracker.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so this only repeats what she could already see there. A seat count isn't a money figure, so no approval was needed.
